name: Idler
blurb: Never moves. If you can't beat this, you have a bug.

name: Drunkard
blurb: Random tiles, random directions, spends every order.

name: Sprawl
blurb: Pushes its biggest stack into the nearest unowned tile.

name: Starter
blurb: Captures what it can beat and marches stacks to the border.

name: Raider
blurb: Builds up, then rushes your core.
